purpose: Gate 0 for selective looking. Measurement-only, no learned gaze policy. Determines whether to proceed to learned-gaze work.

ground_truth.note: Use ImageNet-100 VAL split for targets. Compositing and distractor policy specified below.

factors.note: No separate 'k_glimpses_plus_gist' arm; K is the factor. Gist is always included as specified.

budgets.definition: Pixel budgets per (policy, K) including the gist. Uniform-downsample resolution matched to each (policy,K) budget.

primary_budget.description: ONE primary budget (K=2) for both HEADROOM and VIABILITY. Other budgets (K=1, K=4) are secondary and reported only.

compositing.how_combined: Single-view trunk combines K glimpses + gist by logit averaging (fixed, no learned parameters). Same combination rule for all policies.
compositing.distractor_policy: Targets placed on ImageNet-100 val images per split policy with distractors as specified by benchmark construction (to be fixed in benchmark code).

arms.uniform_downsample: Downsample to matched resolution for budget
arms.oracle: Glimpses at ground-truth target location (knows target location)

heuristic.rule: Exactly one zero-training rule: select glimpse locations by the trunk's own gist-level uncertainty/attention (no learned parameters). Gist features from frozen ff_112 used to compute uncertainty/attention scores; locations chosen by that score.

seeds.name: scene_seed
seeds.what_varies: Scene sampling and glimpse randomness. Trunk is fixed (official ff_112).

HEADROOM.condition: oracle - max(random, uniform) >= 10 pp at primary budget K=2 on all 3 scene seeds
HEADROOM.description: Oracle must beat both random and uniform by >=10pp at primary budget on all seeds.

VIABILITY.condition: heuristic recovers >= 30% of the oracle-random gap at the same primary budget (K=2) on >= 2 of 3 scene seeds
VIABILITY.description: Heuristic must capture meaningful fraction of oracle-random gap.

pass_rule.note: Headroom alone does not authorize learned-gaze work. Both conditions evaluated at primary budget K=2.
